Add a component to the working copy: .voidhash/components/<name>/, a Rust crate with a voidhash-ui
component and its editor panel, under the id project/<name>.

It stays on this computer until 'voidhash publish' creates its first catalog version. Run it in your
project's root, where voidhash.json is.

Usage:
  voidhash new <name> [flags]

Arguments:
  name  The component's slug: lowercase letters, digits and dashes

Flags:
  -h, --help           Show help for this command
      --title <title>  Its title in the paywall editor: letters, digits and spaces (default: from
                       the name)

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash new sale-badge
  voidhash new wheel-picker --title "Wheel picker"
